title: Messerschmitt’s 1950s Jet & an in-Ssm scratchpad! | MSFS Marketplace (HA-200 Saeta & Flight Notes)
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down the latest marketplace drop featuring a rare piece of 1950s aviation history alongside a dedicated cockpit workflow utility—ranging from a twin-turbojet historic trainer to an integrated in-sim scratchpad for your flight clearances.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect each arrival in detail:

• Aviación Española Hispano Aviación HA-200 Saeta (HA-220 Super Saeta): A distinctive 1950s Spanish twin-turbojet military trainer and light attack aircraft co-designed by Juan de la Cruz Martín-Albo, Rafael Rubio Elola, and famous aircraft designer Willy Messerschmitt. Powered by dual Turbomeca Marboré II engines, this package features a detailed vintage cockpit and exterior, modeled basic systems (fuel, electrical, engines, radios, and navigation), an integrated simulator checklist, custom sound pack, and 8 civilian and military liveries.
• Bolivia VFR Flight Notes: A built-in toolbar utility designed to act as an integrated digital pilot scratchpad directly within your cockpit view. Built to let simmers quickly jot down ATC clearances, ATIS info, radio frequencies, assigned headings, altitudes, and approach routing on the fly without juggling external windows or third-party scratchpads.

Whether you're after vintage jet aerobatics in a unique Cold War trainer or looking for a lightweight in-cockpit scratchpad to tidy up your IFR workflow, we evaluate each release to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Which of these add-ons are you picking up?
